cards.answer: Zyra is a mage/support with AP-scaling magic damage. She grows attacking plants from seeds and combines roots with a delayed area knockup.
cards.counterplay: Avoid fighting around her seeds and plants; sidestep her vines and leave her ultimate's area before the knockup.

cards.answer: Seeds periodically spawn near Zyra. Her Q or E can turn them into attacking plants. Enemy champions can destroy seeds by stepping on them after a brief delay.
cards.counterplay: Step on exposed seeds when safe; avoid approaching seeds while Zyra can activate them.

cards.answer: Q deals magic damage in a target area after a short delay. Hitting a seed grows a Thorn Spitter that attacks enemies at range.
cards.counterplay: Move out of the targeted area and keep your distance from activated plants.

cards.answer: W places a seed that grants sight nearby and can be activated by Q or E. Zyra stores seed charges and replenishes them faster through kills or champion takedowns. After a brief delay, enemy champions can step on the seed to destroy it, briefly revealing themselves.
cards.counterplay: Approach placed seeds cautiously; clearing them can reveal your position.
